description: This file provides function declarations for computing HMACs using different hash functions (MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512). It acts as a wrapper for hash-based message authentication codes within the lighttpd project.

methods.name: li_hmac_md5
methods.description: Computes an HMAC using MD5 hash. Outputs a 16-byte digest.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Computes an HMAC using SHA1 hash. Outputs a 20-byte digest.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha256
methods.description: Computes an HMAC using SHA256 hash. Outputs a 32-byte digest.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha512
methods.description: Computes an HMAC using SHA512 hash. Outputs a 64-byte digest.
